content.title: Nvidia's Strong Earnings Soothe Skittish Investors
content.summary: Nvidia reported strong earnings late Wednesday and provided a revenue forecast for the January quarter that was above expectations.  For its October quarter, the chip maker reported adjusted earnings per share of $1.30, compared to Wall Street’s consensus estimate of $1.26, according to FactSet.  For the current quarter, Nvidia forecast a revenue range with a midpoint of $65 billion, above the consensus of $62.2 billion.
